completed.end: Hyun lists Weed at 50,000 won for one day, then sleeps.
CTS Media buys Weed for 3,090,000,000 won. Hyun verifies the money and shares the bankbook and hope with Grandmother. Stop before moving and hospital treatment.
Debt collectors take three billion won, return 90 million and the IOU, and leave after Han Jinsup’s five-year challenge. Stop before the three days of despair.

On the third day Hyun finds hope of earning again. Ninety million remains, fifty million is reserved for the house contract, forty million is available. He will not pay a cancellation penalty. Stops before registering for martial arts.

Hyun completes a year of martial-arts training and game research. Royal Road reaches over 75% of the global game market and over 90% of Korean gamers; its royal wars dominate broadcasts. He is satisfied it has developed as expected. Stop before his cold gaze at the monitor and buying the capsule.

Hyun buys the capsule for ten million won, immediately says Yes, creates Weed as a male human without changing his appearance, selects Serabourg in Rosenheim, and skips the introduction to save time at three hundred thousand won per month. Stops before the flash and arrival in the city.
Arrival in Serabourg, public movement tests, humiliation and decision to go to Training Hall. Stops before instructor introduction.
Instructor guidance, repeated dummy strikes, first strength +1 after six hours and first stats window. Level remains 1, strength is 11. Stops before -Five hours later-.
Vitality and agility each rise by one; Hyun opens inventory with water and ten rye breads, eats briefly and returns to dummy training despite onlookers. Stop before the scarecrow shivering question.

The onlookers debate training; Pluto explains persistent benefits, estimated forty-point strength limit and the time cost. Hyun enjoys progress and continues; the instructor silently approves. Stop before the three-week jump.

After three weeks of game time, Fighting Spirit and Endurance appear; Sword Mastery is Beginner level 3 at 0%, with +30% attack power and +9% attack speed. Gains are STR +28, AGI +25, VIT +22. Hyun resolves to finish before the four-week city restriction ends. Stop before the hunger interruption.
Hunger and dwindling bread lead Hyun to flatter the instructor, share his lunch and recognize their growing affinity. Stop before the Sculpture Mastery question.

continuity: Grandmother remains hospitalized and the old debt is paid. Do not invent an exact current balance.
Three in-game weeks have passed. Training gains are STR +28, AGI +25, VIT +22; Sword Mastery Beginner level 3 at 0%, +30% attack and +9% speed. Fighting Spirit and Endurance have appeared.
Bread is dwindling. Hyun has just shared the instructor’s lunch after flattering him. The instructor hopes Hyun will remember him when famous; their affinity has grown.
Episode 12 choices concern bread/money and promise/thanks, with within-episode callbacks only. Next is the question about Sculpture Mastery, before the moonlight-carving rumor.
